map.📖 判异规则（基于控制限）: 📖 Rule Violation Rules (based on control limits)
map.本工具检测的判异规则: Rule violation rules detected by this tool
map.规则1：1 个点落在 3σ 控制限外: Rule 1: 1 point falls outside the 3σ control limits
map.规则2：连续 9 点落在中心线同一侧: Rule 2: 9 consecutive points on the same side of the center line
map.规则3：连续 6 点递增或递减: Rule 3: 6 consecutive points increasing or decreasing
map.规则4：连续 14 点交替上升下降: Rule 4: 14 consecutive points alternating up and down
map.规则5：连续 3 点中有 2 点落在同一侧 2σ 区外: Rule 5: 2 of 3 consecutive points fall outside the same-side 2σ zone
map.控制限：UCL/LCL = x̄̄ ± 3σ/√n；σ_xbar = σ/√n。: Control limits: UCL/LCL = x-bar ± 3σ/√n; σ_xbar = σ/√n. Any rule violation indicates an out-of-control process, and special causes should be investigated.

map.控制限和规格限是一回事吗？: Are control limits and specification limits the same?
map.不是。控制限 UCL/LCL = 均值 ±3σ/√n 由过程自身波动决定，用于判: No. Control limits UCL/LCL = mean ±3σ/√n are determined by the process own variation, used to judge whether in control; specification limits are given by customer or design requirements. In control is not the same as conforming.
map.为什么点都在界内还要判异？: Why flag a violation when all points are within limits?
map.随机分布也可能出现连续 7 点同侧、连续上升/下降等模式，这些\"非随机\"形态: Random distribution can also produce patterns like 7 consecutive points on the same side or consecutive rise/fall; these "non-random" patterns often appear before exceeding limits, so control chart violation detection looks beyond just limit breaches.
